title: Houston sends Ky images at night about the film

tellings.quote: and I said I wrote Katie and I said does H is does Houston send me images at night about the movie can you ask him if he just did that and she wrote back and she asked Houston and Houston said yes I do s Kai Images

plain: A filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a documentary called the Telepathy Tapes about children said to read minds, says she began getting images at night about her film in 2024. She says she wrote to Katie, the mother of a boy named Houston in Atlanta, asking whether Houston was sending them, and Katie wrote back that Houston said yes, he sends Ky images. If true, it would mean he could send pictures into someone's mind across the country.
